conflicts.ce_equivalent: Manim Community does not support direct shader_folder attributes on standard Mobjects. Implementing this in CE requires custom OpenGLMobject subclasses or writing custom vertex/fragment shaders using CE's OpenGL renderer backend, which has a different API.

conflicts.gl_construct: data_dtype with custom structured numpy arrays
conflicts.ce_equivalent: Manim CE uses standard numpy arrays for points and colors, and does not expose structured dtypes for custom vertex attributes easily.
Manim CE's OpenGL renderer uses a different uniform setting mechanism, typically via shader wrappers or custom material classes.
